notes: Fixed Ninja's Trial opening another automation browser after Stop and Start.
Improved shared browser reuse so supported automations keep using the existing Pockie Ninja browser session.
Preserved browser and game-page recovery introduced in beta.4.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Fixed Ninja's Trial using stale saved browser/CDP settings that could cause a new browser to open after Stop → Start.
Ninja's Trial now always reuses the Hub's shared browser session on port 9222.
Fixed older Ninja's Trial runtime configurations overriding the shared browser URL and endpoint settings.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Kept the shared browser launch guard that prevents duplicate managed browser launches while an existing browser is starting.
Existing Pockie Ninja tabs keep their current server and session when an automation is restarted.
New browser sessions continue to open https://pockieninja.online/ by default.
